# SYNQ 2.5.2 fixture: what a correct 3.0 migration must reproduce

Captured 2026-10-31 from the real SYNQ 2.5.2 (build 77) Release app on an
iOS 27.0 simulator. Every row was created through the app's own UI (Files
picker, Wi-Fi transfer, edit screens, player); nothing was written to the
database by hand. Sections from "Songs" down are generated by
`node --no-warnings tools/expected.mjs` from the copied data, then checked
against the actions below and the screenshots in `screenshots/`.

- `container/Documents/` and `container/Library/Application Support/com.directedbyshawn.synq/`
  are copies of the app's data container, taken after force-quitting the app.
  `synq.db` sha256 `de7e086a38796837bd7d06aff397c44dbe8156b50ae667eeed6c7a858c877818`
  (journal_mode `delete`, no -wal/-shm files).
- `backup/synq-2.5.2-backup.zip` is a real 2.5.2 Settings > Backup archive of the
  same library (made before playback, so it has the same database; backups carry
  no AsyncStorage).
- `audio/` holds the source files (made by `tools/make-audio.sh`); `art/` the images.
- App build: `~/Library/Caches/synq/legacy-2.5.2/` (see `BUILD.md` there).

## What was done in the UI, in order

1. Free tier: Files import of `01 Headlights.mp3`, `02 Overpass.mp3`,
   `03 Static Bloom.mp3`. Only the first is saved (song 1), but importing
   created artist "Mira Vale" (2) and album "Night Drive" (1) for all three.
2. Premium switched on (Settings > Premium Toggle; this local fixture build
   persists `expiration = "never"` exactly as 2.5.2 does for a Lifetime purchase).
3. Wi-Fi transfer of 15 files (songs 2–16), then a Files import of 4 (songs 17–20).
4. Created playlists Late Night (3, with a Photos cover), Road Trip (4), Focus (5),
   Scratch (6). Added songs (playlistSongs 22–40) and liked 6 songs (41–46).
5. Renamed Road Trip to `Road Trip ’26 🚗` (U+2019, emoji).
6. Deleted playlist Scratch (6). Its rows 39–40 stay behind.
7. Retitled song 3 `Static Bloom` → `Static Bloom (2024 Remaster)`.
8. Gave artist Neon Coast (1) a Photos image.
9. Created album "Mixtape Vol. 1" (5), set year 2024, album artists Mira Vale then
   Lúa Moreno, added songs 17, 10, 2, 11 (from each song's Edit > Add to Albums),
   then reordered to 11, 2, 17, 10 (tracks 1–4).
10. Deleted song 12 "Salt & Pepper" (it was in Late Night and Liked Songs).
11. Customization: theme purple `#a888ec`, app icon `icon-mint` (deliberately a
    different color from the theme), haptics off.
12. Settings > Backup (leaves `Documents/backup.zip`).
13. Played Road Trip from Scaffold & Steel, turned shuffle and repeat on, paused
    in Overpass, added Keystone then Glasshouse to the queue. Force-quit.

## The contract, in short

- 19 songs (ids 1–11, 13–20), 7 artists, 5 albums, 4 visible playlists
  (Liked Songs + 3), ids preserved. Song 12 and playlist 6 must not appear.
- Every audio file stays at `Documents/library/{id}/{fileName}`; no file moves.
- Artwork exists for: albums 1, 2, 4; artist 1; playlist 3; song 10 (song-level,
  no album). Nothing else has artwork (the other folders are empty).
- Liked Songs keeps its name (not renamed here) and its order:
  Overpass → Glasshouse → Café Ünïcødé → Keystone → 東京の夜 (Tokyo Night).
- Preferences: accent `#a888ec`, haptics off, shuffle on, repeat on (2.5.2's
  `loop` is a boolean: "repeat all"), premium (lifetime).
- App icon: `icon-mint`. It is not in the data; iOS keeps the alternate icon by
  name across the update, so 3.0 must ship an alternate icon named exactly
  `icon-mint` (and the other six names).
- Playback session: queue of 11 entries (with duplicates), current index 4
  (Overpass), position 7.548148759 s, source playlist 4.
- No join row may point at a missing song, album, artist or playlist after
  migration (the orphans below are dropped, not resurrected).

## Edge cases this fixture exercises (and what 3.0 should do)

| what | where | expected |
|---|---|---|
| Empty title | songs 13, 14, 15, 16, 18 (`title = ""`) | keep the title empty (no invented title); show the file name, as 2.5.2 does (`LOUD.MP3`, `field recording.wav`, …) |
| Untagged formats | WAV (15, 16), uppercase `.MP3` (14; 2.5.2's reader picks by lowercase extension), FLAC with lowercase Vorbis keys (18) | no artists, no album; 18's `TRACKNUMBER=3` was read but dropped because it has no album |
| Bogus m4a track numbers | Blueprints 196609/196610/196611 (2.5.2 read iTunes `trkn` "n/total" as one int: `track = n + total·65536`) | **decision for Shawn**: decode (`track & 0xFFFF` → 1, 2, 3) or keep raw. Either way the album order stays Foundations → Scaffold & Steel → Keystone |
| Track from file name | Lost Signal (`05 Lost Signal.mp3`, no tag) → 5 | keep 5 |
| Track from title prefix | Interlude (tag title `07 Interlude`) → title `Interlude`, track 7 | keep |
| Song in two albums | Overpass (Night Drive #2, Mixtape #2), Lost Signal (Transmissions #5, Mixtape #3) | first albumSongs row is the primary album; artwork follows the first album that has art |
| Comma names | tag `Marlow, The Architect` was split into artists "Marlow" + "The Architect" at import | migrate as two artists (that's what 2.5.2 shows); don't try to re-join |
| Album name case | `night drive` (song 5's tag) merged into "Night Drive" | one album |
| Stale denormalized columns | `songs.artists` / `songs.album` for 2, 10, 11, 17 | ignore them; use the join tables |
| Album add changes song artists | adding to Mixtape added its album artists to songs 2, 10, 11, 17 (artistSongs 24–28) | migrate as stored |
| `edited` flag | 1 for songs 1–5: retitling song 3 re-saved Night Drive's cover and flagged the whole album | `modified_since_export = true` for 1–5 only |
| Durations | integer seconds, floored (m4a reads ~1 s short of ffprobe) | `duration_ms = duration × 1000` (or re-probe; tests should allow ±1000 ms) |
| Unicode names | `Café Ünïcødé.mp3`: DB NFC, disk NFD. `Saoirse Ní Bhriain - Dew Point.flac` (Files import): NFD in DB and disk. `東京の夜.m4a` | open files by the stored name (APFS lookup is normalization-insensitive); never compare DB names to directory listings byte-for-byte |
| `&`, `()`, spaces, leading digits, U+2019, emoji | file names and playlist 4 | preserved byte-for-byte |
| Non-square artwork | Blueprints source 800×450 is stored stretched to 800×800; Glass Garden's embedded PNG is stored as JPEG 500×500 | use the stored files as-is |
| Empty and `undefined` folders | `albums/{3,5,undefined}`, `artists/{2..7,undefined}`, `playlists/{2,4,5,undefined}` | empty folder = no artwork; ignore `undefined` |
| Extra files in Documents | `backup.zip` (2.5.2 never deletes it), `.posthog-rn.json` | ignore; leave in place |
| Orphan join rows | playlistSongs 39–40 (playlist 6), artistSongs 20 (song 12) | drop |
| Hidden Library playlist | playlist 1, one row per live song | not migrated |
| Playlist order | add order (playlistSongs.id) vs what 2.5.2 displayed (the query has no `ORDER BY`; "Date Added" really sorted by song id, newest first) | **decision for Shawn**; the plan's "order survives" most naturally means add order, which 2.5.2 stored but never showed |
| Queue file | `queue` value too long for the manifest → `null` there, JSON in file md5("queue") | read the side file |
| Queue URLs | absolute `file://…/Containers/Data/Application/<UUID>/Documents/…`; the UUID changes on every install/update (seen here: 572C973D… → BA2D2F70… after reinstall, and 2.5.2 then shows "Playback Error ▸ Unable to play Overpass") | rebuild the queue from `id`s; ignore `url`/`artwork`/`title` in the track objects |
| Queue duplicates | ids 3, 6, 7 appear twice (history + reshuffled remainder) | keep duplicates in order |
| Placeholder artwork in queue | track 14's `artwork` is a bundle-asset object (`icon-purple.png`) | ignore |
| Missing AsyncStorage keys | `playAd`, `timePlayed`, `exportNumber` never written for this user | use defaults |
| Strings everywhere | every AsyncStorage value is a string (`"true"`, `"4"`, `"7.548148759"`, `"never"`) | parse |

- `reviewAlreadyRequested` true, `importCount` 1.
